description: A long solo journey through Nerea’s nightmare. Sark searches the city and sewers, survives the haunted houses and forest maze, reaches the party, and battles the timed driving finale across repeated attempts. The successful run was recorded during a Discord stream and later replayed on this Twitch stream, with the ending and his reactions preserved.
